answers.core:
Ellipsoids are just adding one more dimension to the existing spheroid, as a primitive mesh I would expect the ability to create such a shape from the SphereMesh.  It also helps developers easily match collision shapes with the SphereShape3D where it's a true sphere and controlled only by radius:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/17148d86-cd85-4481-a0fb-85ecd176909f)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/211d657a-ab39-4fe2-988f-432ff4357ebb)
answers.workaround: Attempting to use code to get around this limitation seems tedious and intuitive.  You would need to add a script whos sole purpose is to scale the spheroid on an additional axis in order to replicate an ellipsoid.
